name: What should I ask before hiring a pool removal contractor?

mainEntity.name: What questions should I ask a pool removal contractor before hiring them in Los Angeles or nearby cities?
mainEntity.text: What questions should I ask a pool removal contractor before hiring them in Los Angeles or nearby cities?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before hiring a contractor, homeowners should verify scope, experience, and the total cost picture. Important questions include: Is this a partial fill-in or full removal? Who pulls the permit? How will access be handled? Are haul-off, dump fees, backfill, compaction, and grading included? What drainage corrections are planned? What happens to plumbing and electrical lines? Who repairs irrigation, fencing, or hardscape damage? In Los Angeles, it also helps to ask about experience with hillside lots, tight access, and neighborhood protection. A strong contractor should explain the sequence of work clearly and show examples of similar projects. The goal is to compare bids that include the same work, not bids that only look cheaper because they leave major tasks out.
acceptedAnswer.description: Ask about permits, access, hauling, backfill, compaction, drainage, timeline, cleanup, insurance, and whether the estimate is for partial or full removal. Also ask who handles utility locating and what is excluded from the bid. The best contractor can explain local site conditions and show recent pool removal work.
